eps.ov: All Al wants to do is live a tranquil existence as a farmer. Unfortunately for him, unwittingly rescuing the princess means his life is about to become far more complicated.
It was supposed to be a simple gathering quest, but Al’s discovery of a black dragon scale becomes an omen of things to come.

eps.t: The Farmer and The Malevolent Dragon Ouroborus
eps.ov: Al encounters the ghost of Helen’s brother, who begs him to save his sister from Ouroboros.

eps.t: The Farmer and the Life That Was Saved
eps.ov: Ouroboros won’t go down that easily; the battle for Helen’s soul has only just begun.
A fellow adventurer joins Al on his way to Lurugus.

eps.t: The Farmer and The Hero Who Can't Be a Hero
eps.ov: Loki will stop at nothing to ensure the Hero’s bloodline ends with Ruri!

eps.t: The Farmer and The Princess's Resolution
eps.ov: Heavy is the head that wears the crown; Fal must accept a political marriage for the sake of the kingdom.
Al, Helen, and Ruri must expose Nedilus’ evil deeds and thwart his plan! However, everything depends on rescuing a hostage imprisoned in the castle first.
Al had another childhood friend other than Testa, and her name was Ilvia. Al will always remember her.
Linea knows something is wrong in Gull Town and wants the guild to investigate.

eps.t: The Reunion of The Farmer and The Demon King's Castle
eps.ov: Al gets more than he bargains for when he rescues a young girl from her assailants; she’s the daughter of the Demon King, and she needs Al’s help to save demon kind!

eps.t: The Farmer and The New Resolution
eps.ov: Al’s mind reels from a shocking revelation! He has many questions, but he will only receive the answers if he accepts a dark bargain.
